body.name: Centered Boolean collision handle
body.construction: Use \(\mathsf H_B\) to write the difference between \(A_G^2+A_G-(d_n-1)I_n\) and \(B_2(G)\) as centered triangle and repeated-codegree graph matrices, decompose these matrices by graph shape, and apply degree-preserving switching trace moments separately below and above a polylogarithmic degree threshold.
